status: prospective engineering correction; efficacy remains stopped

diagnostic_evidence.observation: With CPU autograd engine multithreading disabled, frame-broadcast repeated exactly. Token-affinity still produced different gradient tensor hashes in seq9 chunk 2 and seq2 chunk 1; first clip losses remained equal. Initial adapter, optimizer, and full RNG matched. This shows the mismatch is not only a gradient-summary formatting issue.
diagnostic_evidence.hypothesis: Parallel intra-op CPU kernels used during token-affinity backpropagation may cause the tiny gradient drift. This cause has not yet been confirmed.

change.only_change: Temporarily set torch intra-op threads to 1 during loss.backward(), gradient validation and reductions, and gradient clipping; restore the frozen 2-thread setting before optimizer.step(). Keep CPU autograd engine multithreading disabled during backward.
unchanged: forward pass and all pretrained model weights

change.reason: Execution scheduling only; the change targets the observed CPU gradient drift and may make the existing exact-replay requirement achievable.

required_checks.scope: Repeat the exact first two frozen training clips twice from clean starts for token-affinity and frame-broadcast arms, then run the complete short engineering gate.
required_checks.pass: Exact match of initial and final adapter/optimizer/RNG states, per-update gradient hashes, losses, receipts, and unchanged pretrained weights for both arms; all other required gate checks pass.
required_checks.failure: Keep efficacy training blocked. Identify the first differing gradient parameter and operation; do not relax equality or tune the method.

interpretation: This amendment addresses engineering reproducibility only. It is not an efficacy result and does not authorize full training until the complete source-bound gate passes.
